revisionDesc.change: Submit - New reading for l. 63 based on the image printed in the edition. A writer seems to have written Ilias 1.400 at the bottom of a column, apparently with no connection to the land register there on the verso, nor to the collection of gnomic sentences on the reused tecto. The letters read by the editor after the three etas are actually still part of the etas themselves, as is typical for Hellenistic writings.
Commit - New reading for l. 63, proposed by analysing the plate in the edition. Additionally, the "i" in "col. vi" was mistakenly given with an iota.
Commit - New reading for l. 63, proposed by analysing the plate in the edition.
Finalized - Ready. Decided to leave the proper name in lin36 as in the edition Ἐπικρά(του) cf. line 44 where Ἐπικράτου is clearly written in full.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Use delta instead of "d" for 1/4.

Text from printed edition. In line 32 I've corrected the accent of Μενῆτος to Μένητος. In line 36 I've corrected Ἐπικρά(του) to Ἐπικρά(τους) and in line 44 I've regularized the same name in the apparatus cf. Σωσικρ[άτ]ους in line 38. I wasn't sure how to enter the X sign used for checking, and thus I used *check?*. There are problematic readings such as: l. 35 εκ ουσης; l. 58 A.νεφρανωρος; l. 63 αει το σεισμων[ , but I left the edition's readings.
